sections.title: Basics
sections.summary: Run flow, rooms, rewards, and the character sheet.

sections.title: Combat
sections.summary: Board rules, timing, defenses, hazards, and card flow.

sections.title: Keywords
sections.summary: Card and enemy terms unlocked as they appear.

sections.title: Magicks
sections.summary: Magic cards recorded when they are gained, offered, or seen in combat.

sections.title: Equipment
sections.summary: Weapons, armor, trinkets, and other gear recorded when discovered.

sections.title: Items
sections.summary: Single-use scavenger cards recorded when carried or offered.

sections.title: Creatures
sections.summary: Enemies recorded the first time they are seen.

entries.title: The Run
body: Explore rooms, survive fights, claim rewards, and push deeper toward the next boss.
Held Embers travel with the run until banked, spent, recovered, or lost.
One attempt through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon. Ends at the last dragon, at defeat or by Embrace.

entries.title: Map and Rooms
body: Revealed exits show where you can travel next. Cleared rooms stay available as routes.
Combat, Ember Hearth, merchant, treasure, relic, and boss rooms each change the next choice.
Each section is a map of rooms. Pick a forward route through combat, Relic, Scavenger, Ember Hearth and other rooms.

entries.title: Character
body: Equipment, magic, item slots, relics, and learned skills shape your deck and tactics.
Most loadout changes happen outside combat, including pre-battle and Ember Hearth moments.
The menu for your gear, magic, items and skills. Gear, magic and items form your deck.

entries.title: Rewards
body: After combat, choose a card, take healing, or claim other room rewards when offered.
Spells go straight into your deck when you gain them. Purge removes one.
After a combat, choose 1 of 3 magic cards, or skip to heal 3. Dragons and Guardians also give relics.

entries.title: Relics
body: Relics are passive run modifiers. Some trigger in combat, some change card values, and some alter rewards.
Hover relic badges in the top HUD for their current text.
Passive effects that last the whole run. Found in Relic rooms and won from dragons and Guardians.

entries.title: Combat Board
body: Cards resolve against board coordinates. A target is legal only when the card's targeting rule, range, line of sight, occupancy, and terrain checks all pass.
Card previews show legal targets, affected tiles, and projected result values before resolution.
Undo move (Z) takes back free movement until you play a card, unless the move revealed or triggered something.
Enemies show their next attack above them: its damage and the order they act in. Red tiles will be struck before your next turn. Press I for every enemy's full plan.
The 9×9 tile grid where combat happens.

entries.title: Turn Clock
body: Each played card adds its printed time to the acting unit's turn delay.
The turn clock orders actors by current delay and previews the next turns.
Each unit has a next-turn time; the lowest acts next, and you win ties. Spending Time pushes yours later.

entries.title: Card Play
body: Each player turn begins with a finite Card Play capacity. Playing a card spends one Card Play unless an effect states otherwise.
Card Play effects add temporary capacity that expires at the end of the current player turn.

entries.title: Health and Defenses
body: Non-piercing damage is applied to Block first, then Stoneskin, then health.
Block clears before that actor’s turn-start Fire damage. Stoneskin persists and can absorb it.
Chilled and Frozen modify direct attack damage. Fire terrain damage does not gain these bonuses or trigger direct-hit riders.
Damage hits Block first, then Stoneskin, then Health. Pierce skips Block and Stoneskin.

entries.title: Defiance
body: Every fourth permanent level grants one Defiance for each new run.
Lethal health loss spends one Defiance to restore 25% max health and continue the same combat.
Defiance never refills during a run. A level milestone reached mid-run adds only the newly earned charge.
Each charge turns lethal damage into 25% Health. You get 1 per 4 levels, refilled each run.

entries.title: Targeting
body: Melee actions target adjacent or pattern-defined nearby tiles. Ranged actions require a legal range and line-of-sight path.
Area actions resolve over a tile pattern. Push and pull resolve forced movement along a legal direction until distance, blockers, or terrain stop the target.
Targets must be visible and within Range. Ranged attacks also need line of sight; walls and outcrops block it.

entries.title: Fatigue
body: When a draw request empties the draw pile, the discard pile reshuffles into a new draw pile.
Each reshuffle increments fatigue. Fatigue deals direct health loss that bypasses block.
When you must draw from an empty draw pile, reshuffle your discard and lose 2 Health, +1 each time.

entries.title: Traps
body: Entering or striking a trap triggers damage on its tile and creates ground on its four cardinal neighbors. Air traps instead push adjacent characters outward.
Trigger once when entered or hit. They damage their tile and spread their element to the 4 tiles around.

entries.title: Outcrops
body: Outcrop cards raise crag outcrops on empty floor. An outcrop blocks movement and line of sight, can be attacked like other terrain, and leaves Rubble when destroyed.

A tile is legal only when the raise keeps every floor tile connected, so an outcrop can never seal the hero, an enemy, a pickup or an exit away. A Worldspine cage is the one exception: it may seal the single tile it surrounds.

Powder kegs and Worldspines are raised the same way. A keg blocks movement but not sight; when anything destroys it, it deals its damage to its tile and each tile next to it, setting off other kegs. Your Worldspines pulse at the start of each of your turns, hitting each enemy next to one of them once.
Rockburst and Worldbreak destroy terrain to blast the enemies next to it, or the line beyond an outcrop you raised.
Raises attackable terrain with the shown Health. It blocks movement; some kinds also block sight.
Worldspines block movement, not sight, and leave Rubble when destroyed.

entries.title: Lightning Strikes
body: Calls Lightning attacks down on the displayed tiles. Lightning can reach additional enemies through connected Electrified tiles.
Strikes the marked tiles for the shown damage, then turns them Electrified, replacing its old field.

entries.title: Summon
body: Creates additional enemies on the board.
Calls the shown enemy, up to a limit of living ones. Killing a summon grants no Card Play.

entries.title: The Umbra
body: The Umbra hides board tiles beyond your current vision. Enemies concealed within it cannot be directly targeted, and their identities, intents, and threat previews remain hidden.
Umbra stages grow more severe deeper in the labyrinth. Radiance effects create light, extend your vision, reveal hidden enemies, or reduce the room's Umbra stage.
Darkness that limits your sight. Hidden enemies show no intent and can't be targeted. Attacks that hit an area hit hidden enemies on those tiles too.

entries.title: Melee
body: Attacks targets at close range.
Deal that much damage to an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.

entries.title: Ranged
body: Attacks distant targets within range and line of sight.
Deal that much damage to a target within Range and line of sight.

entries.title: Move
body: Walks across reachable tiles using the displayed movement allowance. Walking out of Rubble costs 2 movement instead of 1.
Walk up to that many tiles around obstacles, triggering ground and traps you enter. Pick your own tile to stay.

entries.title: Blink
body: Teleports to a destination without crossing the tiles between. Landing triggers the destination’s ground and traps.
Teleport to a visible open tile within that many tiles, ignoring anything between. Pick your own tile to stay.

entries.title: Block
body: Absorbs damage before Stoneskin and Health. Clears at the start of your next turn.
Absorbs damage before Health. Lost at the start of its holder's next turn.

entries.title: Stoneskin
body: Absorbs damage after Block and before Health. Remains between turns.
Absorbs damage after Block. Lasts until used up or combat ends.

entries.title: Heal
body: Restores Health up to your maximum.
Restore that much Health, up to the maximum.

entries.title: Draw
body: Adds cards from your draw pile to your hand.
Draw that many cards. Your hand holds at most 7.

entries.title: Card Play
body: Grants additional Card Plays this turn.
Playing a card spends 1. Refills each turn. Killing an enemy on your turn grants 1 more, except summons.

entries.title: Follow-up
body: Gains its listed bonus if you already played another card this turn. The bonus is decided when the card starts, and the card's numbers update in your hand while it is active.
If you already played a card this turn: gain the listed bonus.

entries.title: Empower
body: An optional extra cost. Charge the card with the Empower seal on its top-right corner (or press E; the right stick on a controller). A charged card glows and stays charged until you play it or your turn ends.
The cost is paid when the card finishes: extra Time added to your next turn, health paid after the card resolves (Block does not prevent it), or Exhaust.
Pay the extra cost as you play this card to gain its bonus. Charge it with the card's seal.

entries.title: Stagger
body: Pushes the struck enemy's next turn later on the turn clock by the Stagger value. Dragons take half, rounded down.
Each enemy can be delayed by at most 6 per player turn. Hover a Stagger target to preview its new place in the turn order.
Delays the target's next turn by this much Time. Dragons take half. At most 6 per enemy each turn.

entries.title: Illusion
body: Creates a stationary decoy with the displayed Health. Enemies can target it.

Some illusions carry an effect while they live: enemies that damage a charged illusion take damage back (once per enemy attack), and a Doppelganger lets your ranged attacks fire from its tile. Mirror Feint places its illusion beside an enemy; Hall of Mirrors fills every empty tile next to you.

Empty Husk swaps you with one of your illusions and moves your Block onto it as extra health. Shattered Reflection destroys one of your illusions to blast each enemy next to it. Both count as normal arrivals and destruction for illusion effects.
Create a decoy with that much Health. Enemies attack it when it's at least as close as you.

entries.title: Immobilize
body: Prevents Move and Blink (and the hero’s swaps) on the affected character’s next turn.

entries.title: Exhaust
body: Removes the card from your deck for the rest of combat.
After use, this card leaves your deck until combat ends.

entries.title: Retaliate
body: Until the start of your next turn, an enemy whose melee attack hits you takes the Retaliate amount. Block and Stoneskin absorb it; Chill, Freeze and Expose do not add to it.
Melee means a melee attack or any attack made from a tile next to you. Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack. Several Retaliates add their damage and Bleed; Shock and Push use the largest.
A foe defeated by Retaliate pays its normal rewards but does not refund a Card Play.
Until your next turn, each enemy that hits you up close takes that much damage and the listed effects.
an illusion's Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack.

entries.title: Quicken
body: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time, to a minimum of 1. The card that grants Quicken never discounts itself.
Several Quickens add up. Unused Quicken ends with your turn. The Time badge shows the discount.
Your next card this turn costs that much less Time, minimum 1. Unused Quicken ends with your turn.

entries.title: Next Attack
body: Your next attack on a later card this turn gains the listed bonus: extra damage, Pierce, or Chain. A bonus naming an element waits for an attack of that element.
Several bonuses add up and are spent together by that attack. Unused bonuses end with your turn.
Your next attack on a later card this turn gets the shown bonus. Unused bonuses end with your turn.

entries.title: Rite
body: Rite: Exhaust. Lasts for the rest of this combat.
Playing a Rite removes the card for this combat and keeps its rule active until the combat ends, like a relic. Rites never carry into the next combat.
Its effect lasts for the rest of this combat. Exhaust.

entries.title: Health Cost
body: Health paid when you play the card. Ignores Block and Stoneskin.
Lose that much Health when the card finishes. Block and Stoneskin don't prevent it.

entries.title: Pierce
body: Deals damage through Block and Stoneskin, leaving those defenses intact.
This damage ignores Block and Stoneskin.

entries.title: Bleed
body: Deals its displayed damage before each movement or attack action. Clears after the affected character’s next turn.
Before each move or attack, it takes damage equal to its Bleed. Clears when its turn ends.

entries.title: Freeze
body: Skips the next turn and takes triple damage from attacks until thawing.
Skips its next turn. Takes triple damage from attacks until then.
Shatter checks Freeze before the hit, and its splash damage is not tripled.

entries.title: Shock
body: Cancels the affected character’s next non-movement action.
Chain and conducted hits Shock too.

entries.title: Expose
body: The next hit against the target deals additional damage equal to Expose.
The next attack that damages it deals that much more damage. Then Expose ends.

entries.title: Sunder
body: Removes the displayed amount of Block, then Stoneskin, before dealing attack damage.
Before damage, remove up to that much Block, then Stoneskin, from the target.

entries.title: Chain
body: Jumps between enemies and Electrified tiles within the displayed distance. Each enemy is hit once per attack.
Jump to a new target within that many tiles, repeating from each one. Electrified tiles relay the jump.

entries.title: Push
body: Forces the target away from the attack’s origin in one straight line for the displayed distance. It never turns or slides around anything.
When the target is off to a diagonal, it goes along the longer side by default; Rotate switches to the other side before you commit.
If a wall, crate, outcrop, character or illusion stops it early, it collides.
Move the target that many tiles straight away from the source. If blocked: Collision.
in an area push each enemy moves along its own straight line; stopped lines collide.

entries.title: Pull
body: Forces the target toward the attack’s origin in one straight line for the displayed distance. It never turns or slides around anything.
When the target is off to a diagonal, it comes along the longer side by default; Rotate switches to the other side before you commit.
A pull that reaches its source simply stops. Anything else that stops it early makes it collide.
Move the target that many tiles straight toward the source. If blocked before reaching it: Collision.
in an area pull each enemy moves along its own straight line; stopped lines collide.

entries.title: Collision
body: When forced movement is stopped by a wall, crate, outcrop, character or illusion, the target takes 2 damage for each tile it didn't move, and so does whatever it hit. Walls take nothing.
Block and Stoneskin absorb it; Chilled, Frozen and Expose don't add to it.
A stopped Push or Pull deals 2 damage per lost tile to the target and to its blocker.

entries.title: Consume
body: Removes the item card from the run after use.
After use, this item is gone for the rest of the run.

entries.title: Radiance
body: Radiance reveals the Umbra through Light, Vision, Truesight and Dispel Umbra.
Cards and skills that counter the Umbra with Light, Vision, Truesight and Dispel Umbra.

entries.title: Light
body: Creates light that reveals nearby Umbra within the displayed radius. Its duration counts down on player turns.
Reveals tiles within its radius through the Umbra for the shown number of your turns.

entries.title: Vision
body: Expands the light around you for the displayed number of turns.
Widen your sight radius by that much for the shown turns. It creates no Light.

entries.title: Truesight
body: Reveals enemies through the Umbra and lets you target them. Lasts for the displayed number of turns.
For the shown turns, every enemy counts as visible: you see its intent and can target it.

entries.title: Dispel Umbra
body: Reduces the room’s Umbra stage for the rest of combat.
Lower the Umbra by that many stages for the rest of this combat.

entries.title: Tunnel Crawler
body: Fast close-range predator that closes distance and opens bleed wounds.
Its intents favor short movement paths followed by melee bleed attacks.

entries.title: Dust Acolyte
body: Ranged caster with dust bolt attacks, self-defense actions, and health-draining effects.
Its intents alternate between line-of-sight damage and preservation.

entries.title: Bone Harrier
body: Mobile ranged skirmisher with pierce and bleed attacks.
Its intents often combine repositioning with a ranged strike.

entries.title: Stone Warden
body: Durable front-line guard with heavy melee attacks, block gains, and close area strikes.
It can absorb damage through defenses before its health is exposed.

entries.title: Cinder Ooze
body: Fire ooze whose attacks leave Fire tiles. Slag Shell Expends nearby Fire for extra Block; killing the ooze can split it into droplets.

entries.title: Cinder Droplet
body: Small Fire fragment spawned by a Cinder Ooze. Its attacks leave Fire tiles.

entries.title: Shale Bloomer
body: Earth controller whose attacks cover the struck tiles in Rubble and Expose targets. Shale Shell Expends nearby Rubble for additional Stoneskin.

entries.title: Chainbound Gaoler
body: Air-locked jailer that pulls, pushes, and restricts movement.
Its intents use forced movement and immobilize to alter reachable tiles.

entries.title: Grave Surgeon
body: Support enemy that heals and guards allies. Its guard clears elemental ground beneath its target.

entries.title: Frostglass Lancer
body: Ice striker that creates Ice tiles and follows up with Freeze. Refract Guard clears Ice beneath the Lancer.

entries.title: Zekarion, the Raging Tempest
body: Storm dragon supported by Lightning Wisps. Skybreak and Storm Lash leave Electrified ground.
When Zekarion uses Overload, lightning strikes every Electrified tile for 5, with Chain 1. At half Health the Chain grows to 2. Stay off charged ground, or lure its Wisps onto it.

entries.title: Lightning Wisp
body: Lightning minion that creates Electrified tiles. Capacitor Arc inflicts Shock when conducted through Electrified.

entries.title: Worldspines
body: Tharokh marks a line of tiles between you and it. After every second turn of yours, the marked tiles rise as Outcrops: stone that blocks movement until it is broken. At half Health they rise after each of your turns.
Outcrops block Tharokh and its Burrow Grubs too. Break one to open a route.

entries.title: Meteorfall and Crownfire
body: Meteorfall strikes marked tiles and leaves Fire. When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions.
Crownfire detonates Vyraketh's own marked Fire while it pursues you. Replace the Fire to deny the blast, or lure the dragon into it.

The Meteorfall card marks a line of tiles the same way. The marks stay through enemy turns; at the start of your next turn, before you draw, each marked tile takes the damage (anyone standing there, including you) and becomes Fire.
Marks the shown tiles. When it lands, they take the shown damage and become Fire.

entries.title: Hollow Gale
body: Hollow Gale strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx and Pushes struck actors away.
After each Vaeloryx turn, its wind Pushes everyone 1 tile, then turns a quarter clockwise.
Eye of the Storm threatens a wide ring after the dragon retreats. Escape the outer edge, or step into the eye and face a weaker bite.

entries.title: Gusts and Vortices
body: An area force pushes or pulls every enemy within its radius of a center: you, or a tile you choose. Each enemy moves along its own straight line away from (Push) or toward (Pull) the center, using the normal Push and Pull rules. An enemy standing on a Pull's center stays put.
Pushes resolve farthest from the center first; pulls resolve nearest first. A stopped line collides as usual: 2 damage per lost tile to the mover and to what stopped it.
Squall pushes each enemy in its cross away from the cross's center; the enemy on the center itself is pushed away from you.

entries.title: Swap
body: Swap places with a visible one-tile enemy or one of your illusions within range and line of sight. Large enemies cannot be swapped.
Both of you arrive normally: ground and traps trigger for each, and you collect loot on your new tile. A swap is not a Push or Pull, so nothing collides and Anchored does not stop it.
Trade places with a visible one-tile enemy or your illusion. Both trigger the ground where they land.

entries.title: Stances
body: Skate: this turn, moving onto Ice costs no movement and Ice doesn't Chill you.
Immobilize: for the rest of this turn you can't Move, Blink or Swap, including your own movement.
Anchored: until your next turn, Push and Pull against you move you 0 tiles and never collide.
Fireproof: Fire doesn't damage you this turn.
Active stances appear as badges on your character.
Push, Pull and Wind don't move it or cause a Collision. Yours lasts until your next turn.

entries.title: Cleanse
body: Cleanse removes the listed statuses from you at once: Bleed, Immobilize, Chilled or Shock. Removing Immobilize or Shock frees you for the rest of this turn, and a Shock cleanse can be played while Shocked.
Removing Chilled while standing on Ice keeps you unchilled until you next enter Ice or start a turn on it.

entries.title: Petrify
body: A Petrified enemy skips its next turn. The skipped turn still costs its normal Time on the Turn Clock, so it does not come back sooner.
Petrify also gives the enemy 5 Block, which lasts through your next turn. It is not Freeze: there is no damage multiplier and no Chill interaction. Dragons cannot be Petrified.
Skips its next turn, still paying its Time, and gains 5 Block through your next turn. Dragons are immune.

entries.title: Crystal Mantle
body: Each direct damaging hit breaks one Crystal Mantle layer instead of damaging health. Cheap hits can clear layers before a heavy strike.
Each remaining layer extends Shatterstorm by one tile. Break layers during its warning to shrink the danger; the burst breaks the layers that remain.
Ice beneath Iskaldra can fuel an extra layer. Remove the visible fuel before its turn to deny the bonus.

Crystal Mantle cards give you the same layers: each direct hit against you breaks one layer instead of dealing damage. Fire, Bleed, collisions, traps and health costs bypass it. Your layers last until broken or the combat ends.
Each layer cancels 1 direct hit, then breaks. Ground damage, Bleed, Collision and traps bypass it.

entries.title: Last Eclipse
body: Night Coil extinguishes a marked brazier before Noctyrax announces Last Eclipse. Walk or Blink onto an unlit brazier to relight it.
Light blocks Eclipse's darkness. Relight a refuge or create Light, but evade or guard against the fixed marked ground. Refuges stay lit until Night Coil.
Noctyrax replaces defeated Acolytes, up to two alive. They hide in Umbra; Light and truesight reveal them.
Unprotected targets take the shown damage, then the Umbra becomes Eclipse for 2 turns. Light, Vision and Truesight protect you.

entries.title: Veilbound Acolyte
body: Shadow minion that fights beside Noctyrax and disappears when Umbra hides its tile.
Radiance and truesight reveal its position before its ranged needles and closing strikes resolve.

entries.title: Tharokh, the Worldspine
body: Earth dragon that walls you in, with Burrow Grubs at its side.
After every second turn of yours, Tharokh's marked tiles rise as Outcrops. At half Health they rise after each of your turns. Break through before the wall closes.

entries.title: Vyraketh, the Cinder Crown
body: Fire dragon that lays marked Fire, with Cinder Droplets that leave more of it.

When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions. At half Health its Fire spreads after every second Vyraketh turn. Crownfire detonates its own marked Fire, and its bite renews the marks.

entries.title: Vaeloryx, the Hollow Gale
body: Air dragon that strikes from the sky and dives at you, with Gust Shrikes riding its wind.
After each Vaeloryx turn, its wind Pushes everyone 1 tile, then turns a quarter clockwise. At half Health it Pushes 2 tiles. Its retreating storm combines a wide ring with a weaker close bite.

entries.title: Iskaldra, the Rime Tyrant
body: Ice dragon protected by visible Crystal Mantle layers, with Rime Spitters laying Ice around it.

When Iskaldra uses Rime Talon, Frostbite hits everyone on Ice for 3 and Freezes them. At half Health, Frostbite hits after every second Iskaldra turn instead. Break Mantle layers to shrink Shatterstorm's reach.

entries.title: Noctyrax, the Last Eclipse
body: Shadow dragon and final boss of the twenty-fourth depth, with Veilbound Acolytes hiding in its darkness.
When Noctyrax uses Void Claw, hidden Veilbound Acolytes Blink 3 tiles toward you. Night Coil snuffs a brazier; enter its tile to relight it. Light blocks Eclipse's darkness.

entries.title: Ground
body: A tile can hold Rubble and one elemental ground: Fire, Ice or Electrified. Ground remain until Expended, replaced, removed or combat ends.
Place the shown ground on the shown tiles. A tile holds Rubble plus one other ground.

entries.title: Fire
body: Deals 3 damage at turn start and 2 damage when entered.
A unit that enters takes 2 damage. One that starts its turn here takes 3.

entries.title: Ice
body: Entering or starting a turn on Ice applies Chilled. Leaving Ice removes Chilled.
A unit that enters or starts its turn here is Chilled until it leaves.

entries.title: Electrified
body: Lightning attacks travel through connected Electrified tiles, hitting enemies on them. Chain can also jump through individual Electrified tiles.
Frost Circuit turns a connected patch of Ice into Electrified ground. Discharge removes a connected Electrified network and strikes each enemy on or next to it once.
A Lightning hit that touches it spreads to every foe on connected Electrified tiles. Chain relays through it.

entries.title: Rubble
body: Walking out of Rubble costs 2 movement instead of 1. With movement remaining, the first step is always allowed.

entries.title: Chilled
body: Takes 2 more damage from attacks. An Ice attack Freezes it and Expends the Ice beneath.

entries.title: Detonate
body: Expends selected Fire tiles to damage targets on them and their four cardinal neighbors. Overlapping blasts hit each target once.
Expend the chosen Fire, or the shown ground. Hit everyone on those tiles and next to them once, including you.
this includes you, illusions, enemies and terrain; kegs set each other off.

entries.title: Expend
body: Removes the displayed ground to gain the stated effect.
Remove the shown ground from its tile to power the listed effect.
the ground is removed after the hit.

entries.title: Relocate Ground
body: Moves a ground from one tile to another.
Move one ground tile to another open tile.

entries.title: Reflect
body: Single-target ranged hits from more than 1 tile away bounce back to the attacker. Melee, area and Chain hits land.

entries.title: Flying
body: Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage. Push, Pull and Gust still move it.

entries.title: Marked
body: These tiles take the hit on this enemy's next turn.

entries.title: Charge
body: Gains Charge each use. At 3, its next intent is Arc Burst: lightning jumping between nearby units. Shock removes 1.

entries.title: Gust
body: On its beat, the wind Pushes every unit downwind. Anchored units don't move.

entries.title: Bursts
body: When it dies, it deals the shown damage to every unit in the 8 tiles around it, then leaves Fire.

entries.title: Range
body: Maximum distance in tiles, counted without diagonals.

entries.title: Time
body: Cards cost Time; the more you spend, the later your next turn. Playing under 2 cards adds Wait.

entries.title: Eclipse
body: The darkest Umbra stage: you see only 1 tile around you. Light still reveals; Dispel Umbra lowers it.

entries.title: Skate
body: This turn, stepping onto Ice costs no movement, and Ice doesn't make you Chilled.

entries.title: Fireproof
body: This turn, Fire ground doesn't damage you.

entries.title: Convert Ground
body: Turn the chosen ground tile, and its connected tiles when shown, into another ground. Hit each enemy on them.

entries.title: Discharge
body: Remove a connected Electrified network. Hit each enemy on it or next to it once.

entries.title: Swap Illusion
body: Swap with one of your visible illusions, anywhere unless a Range is shown.
both of you trigger the ground and traps where you land.

entries.title: Shatter Illusion
body: Destroy one of your illusions in range. Hit each enemy next to it.
it counts as destroyed for illusion effects.

entries.title: Health
body: At 0 Health a unit is defeated or terrain breaks. Your Health carries over between rooms.

entries.title: Terrain Burst
body: Hits units around terrain pieces for the shown damage. Some uses destroy the terrain too.
it happens at the start of each of your turns, once per enemy however many spires touch it.

entries.title: Crownfire
body: Detonate the Fire on its last Cinder Marks. Everyone caught is hit once, the dragon included.

entries.title: Guard Ally
body: Gives the shown Block to one or more enemies, sometimes including itself.

entries.title: Heal Ally
body: Restores the shown Health to a wounded enemy, possibly itself.

entries.title: Embers
body: Earned from kills and victories. Spend them on wares and levels. Dying drops them; recover them next run.

entries.title: Fire
body: Card element. Fire cards mostly place Fire ground and Detonate it.

entries.title: Ice
body: Card element. Ice cards place Ice ground, and an Ice attack Freezes a Chilled target.

entries.title: Lightning
body: Card element. Lightning cards place Electrified ground; a damaging Lightning attack spreads through it.

entries.title: Air
body: Card element. Air cards move units with Push and Pull, and move you.

entries.title: Earth
body: Card element. Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.

entries.title: Skill Point
body: Earned as you level up. Spend them on skills in the Character menu.

entries.title: Moltshards
body: Won from your first dragon each run. Trade 1 for 250 Embers, or spend 1 to reset your skills.

entries.title: Wait
body: Each of your first 2 Card Plays left unused adds 5 Time to your next turn.

entries.title: Turns
body: Counts down at the start of each of your turns. The effect ends at 0; ∞ lasts all combat.

entries.title: Movement
body: Tiles you can walk each turn without a card or Time. Refills at the start of your turn; base 2.

entries.title: Item
body: A card equipped in one of your 2 item slots. It joins your deck and has Consume.

entries.title: Outcrop
body: Attackable terrain that blocks movement. Worldspines and Powder Kegs count as Outcrops. Plain ones also block sight and leave Rubble.

entries.title: Ground Techniques
body: Expend: an attack that Expends a ground deals its bonus to each enemy it hits that stands on that ground, then removes the ground beneath it. An area Expends the ground on every tile of its pattern. Some attacks can only target an enemy standing on the ground. Any ground the attack leaves is placed after the Expend.
Convert: Frost Circuit turns the chosen Ice tile and all Ice connected to it into Electrified ground, then strikes and Shocks each enemy on the converted tiles.
Discharge: choose an Electrified tile. Each enemy on its connected network or next to it takes the damage once, then the network is removed.
Wards leave a ground beneath each enemy next to you. Ice placed this way Chills an enemy only when it starts a turn on or enters the Ice.

entries.title: Sweeping Strike
body: Some cards strike every enemy you can see that meets a condition: standing on Fire or Electrified ground, Chilled, or in Light. There is no target to choose, and an enemy hidden by the Umbra is never hit.
Each strike is a direct hit of the card's element, so an Ice strike Freezes a Chilled enemy. The card can be played only while at least one enemy qualifies.
Hit every enemy you can see that meets the shown condition, within Range if shown. No target to choose.
